objective: Compose one explicit canonical relationship cohort with attributed views and durable outcome facts, then delegate dimension-level quote and bind analytics entirely to INS-004B.

readPlan.attributedViews: at most one getViews call over the canonical cohort
readPlan.outcomeFacts: at most one listForRelationships call over the same canonical cohort

rules: Relationship IDs are canonically validated and deduplicated at the application boundary while preserving first occurrence order.
The identical canonical relationship ID array is supplied to attributed economics and durable outcome readers.
Non-empty cohorts load attributed views and durable outcome facts concurrently.
The attributed view application is called at most once.
The durable outcome reader is called at most once.
An empty canonical cohort performs zero downstream reads and delegates empty data directly to INS-004B.

INS-004B remains sole owner of dimension validation, presentation grouping, durable quote and bind counting, fact validation, bound-does-not-imply-quoted semantics, deterministic buckets, and exact rates.
No mutable quoteStatus value is used as outcome evidence.
